Teams & people

Working Together

With CEOs

Align to their strategic goals and outline a marketing plan that supports them. Reporting directly to CEOs and founders has been the norm for most of a 15+ year career.

With Product

Provide market feedback on gaps and opportunities for innovation, and stay close to what's coming so new capabilities get promoted the moment they ship.

With Sales

Speak the same language. Align on definitions and qualification, then back it up with materials, coaching, and closed-loop feedback.

With Biz Dev

Arm the team with campaign materials, training, scripts, emails, and account lists, and implement the tools that make outbound work.

With Marketing

The team runs on empowered accountability: clear goals and the freedom to achieve them, with support when and if it's needed. Not every problem needs solving from the top.

With Boards

Prepare board materials and internal messaging, respond to requests, and make strategic recommendations.

About Stephen

With 15+ years in B2B tech and SaaS, Stephen has led marketing through multiple growth stages, from first marketing hire to managing global teams and multi-million dollar budgets. He has been part of four acquisitions and an IPO, and is an advanced AI operator who builds with these tools daily. He currently leads global marketing at Checkit from Palm Harbor, Florida.

Stephen holds an MBA in International Business from Liberty University and a B.A. in Communications from Eastern Nazarene College.

He lives in Palm Harbor, FL with his wife Whitney and their four girls, and enjoys golfing, going to the beach, and traveling to new places.
